info.description: Research-only prototype over fictional data. Possible record matches for research and human review only. Similarity scores are not identity probabilities. Names and this reference snapshot cannot establish identity, wrongdoing or sanctions status; selecting none is not a clearance. The actor label is supplied by the calling interface and is not authentication. Review outcomes are only candidate_for_follow_up, none_selected or unresolved, recorded by an authenticated human reviewer.
info.title: Polyglot Watchlist review API (research only)
